Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!
Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants, bridges, dentures, and crowns.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: Best Cleaning I’ve had in a long time!!! My hygienist was very thorough, and you can tell she took pride in what she did and how her work was. My teeth felt amazing after and still do. I had a very enjoyable time at my appointment. I also came to them for a previous filling that had cracked, and now I had a hole in my tooth. The dentist was amazing! The office was able to schedule me sooner than later. I also couldn’t have asked for a better Dentist! He was knowledgeable, and you can tell he was a perfectionist who took pride in great work. I was in good hands. My tooth feels amazing and is back to being normal. I won’t be seeing anyone else. Great staff, very helpful, polite, and professional. Thank you so much to everyone there!

Just had my first visit to Riccobene Associates in Wake Forest, and they went above and beyond in my opinion. I had scheduled a cleaning, and the dental hygienist was thorough in her examination and, as a new patient, thankfully asked how long ago I enrolled in my dental insurance before she performed the cleaning. When I said we switched dental insurance 5 months ago, she double-checked with the office manager on my insurance coverage. The office manager was caring and polite, and informed me that my insurance would not cover a cleaning until after the first six months of coverage. She let me schedule a cleaning for one month later instead. This shows me that they care about not just their patients' dental health but also saving them money when they can. I, for one, really appreciated that. I will be back.

I have had a couple of chips on my front tooth that have been bothering me for a few years. I’ve been told by a couple of other dentists that the chips could only be reshaped, but not filled, which I did not want because I wanted my natural tooth shape. The doctor fixed everything so perfectly and made it look exactly like my natural tooth. He respected my wishes not to shave down my natural tooth and talked me through every step. He is extremely patient, professional, and artistic with the tooth compositing. I am so happy and can’t believe how good my teeth look. His assistant was also so patient and warm. I’m very happy and highly recommend!!

The entire staff took good care of me and made me feel at home. Honestly, the dentist's office has NEVER been my Happy Place, but they went above and beyond to give me a good experience. Personable, caring, attentive, and professional. The hygienist was very gentle but thorough. Thank you to the entire staff.

The team at Wake Forest Riccobene has been very welcoming to me and my family of 5. The doctor is professional, caring, thoughtful, and has a good sense of humor. His assistants explain everything so well. We have seen both hygienists and even some temps when they were out on vacation, and had nothing but a pleasant experience. The office is very cozy; it's not a huge office, which I like. Don't hesitate to give them a try!!!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are available at your Wake Forest office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

What cosmetic dentistry options do you offer in Wake Forest?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Can I get emergency dental care the same day in Wake Forest?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you offer dental implants or other restorative solutions at Wake Forest?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants, bridges, dentures, and crowns.

How often should I schedule routine checkups and cleanings in Wake Forest?

We recommend scheduling dental checkups every six months, though if your needs require more frequent visits, our expert team will provide you with the care you deserve.

What X-ray technology do you use to ensure safe modern dental care in Wake Forest?

We use digital X-rays, which have a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, as well as panoramic X-rays, where you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Do you perform wisdom teeth removal at your Wake Forest office?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

Do you screen for oral cancer at your Wake Forest dental practice?

Yes, we offer oral cancer screenings. Early cancer detection is critical for proper treatment and recovery. Your health is our priority.
